div.head: II Cn 7
div.ab: Licceteras ⁊ leogeras, ryperas ⁊ reaferas Godes graman habban, butan hig geswican ⁊ þe deoppar gebetan.
Licceras ⁊ leogeras, reperas ⁊ reaferas Godes graman habban, buton hig geswycan ⁊ þe deoppor gebeten.
Liceteras ⁊ leogeras, riperas ⁊ reaferas Godes graman habban, buton hig geswican.
Liguritores (seductores; adulatores), mendaces, rapaces raptores Dei grauamen habeant, nisi cessent et prolixius emendent.
Liceteras ⁊ leogeras, ryperas ⁊ hreaferas Godes graman habban, buton hig geswican ⁊ ðe deoppor gebetan.
Licceteras and leogeras, ryperas and reaferas Godes graman habban butan hig geswican and þe deoppar gebetan.
Betrüger (Lecker? A) und Lügner, Räuber und Plünderer sollen Gottes Zorn haben, ausser wenn sie [vom Bösen] abstehen und um so tiefer büssen.
Hypocrites (lickers? A) and liars, robbers and plunderers shall have God's anger, unless they desist [from evil] and atone all the more deeply.
Hypocrites and liars, robbers and plunderers shall incur the wrath of God, unless they desist and make amends to the utmost.
Hypocrites and liars, robbers and plunderers, shall incur God’s anger, unless they desist and atone very deeply.
Hypocrites and liars, thieves and looters will suffer God’s wrath unless they cease and most sincerely repent.
div.note: A's ‘Licceras’ was the reading before Quadr. and Consiliatio.
